## Requirements quality

- [ ] CHK001 Every user story states why its priority and how it is independently testable
- [ ] CHK002 Every FR has at least one acceptance scenario and one test reference
- [ ] CHK003 Ambiguities carry `[NEEDS CLARIFICATION]` and were resolved by `/speckit-clarify`
- [ ] CHK004 Success criteria are measurable and technology-agnostic

## Constitution compliance (P1–P14)

- [ ] CHK005 Clean-clone `docker compose up -d` still suffices (P1)
- [ ] CHK006 No platform-specific logic in the core domain; capabilities matrix respected (P3)
- [ ] CHK007 Business logic in FastAPI; automation only calls API endpoints (P5)
- [ ] CHK008 Actor/agent permissions enforced in code, not prompts (P7)
- [ ] CHK009 Approval defaults intact; any relaxation justified and recorded (P8)
- [ ] CHK010 No secrets in source, logs, images or bundles; tokens encrypted at rest (P9)
- [ ] CHK011 State transitions and audit events cover the change (P10)
- [ ] CHK012 Contract updated before/with implementation; no drift (P11)

## Capabilities: supported vs available (P14)

- [ ] CHK013 Each capability touched is marked `available` or `supported-only` with its source
- [ ] CHK014 Nothing in UI/docs claims a capability without a live, permitted path
- [ ] CHK015 Phase scope respected: no later-phase capability implemented, only extension points

## Verification & evidence (P12)

- [ ] CHK016 `make check` passes locally and in CI; output recorded
- [ ] CHK017 Each acceptance criterion exercised with command + result pasted below
- [ ] CHK018 Two-account / cross-workspace isolation tested where data is exposed
- [ ] CHK019 Failure paths tested (bad input, adapter error, restart mid-job)
- [ ] CHK020 No test skipped, weakened or suppressed to make checks pass

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
